form.title: Create a space
form.intro16: Anyone can create a space, and you become its owner. Because you’re 16 or over, your space is for members 16 and over, and anyone, with or without an account, can read it. You can change everything below later.
form.introUnder16: Anyone can create a space, and you become its owner. Because you’re under 16, your space is for members under 16, and you choose who can read it. You can change everything below later.
form.introUnknown: We need to know your age group before you can start a space.
form.logIn: Log in to create a space.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Each name can only be used once. You can name a space after a book or an author.
form.rulesHint: One rule a line. Shown at the top of your space. The community guidelines always apply as well.
form.whoJoinsText: Spaces keep age groups apart. A space started by someone under 16 takes only under-16s. A space started by someone 16 or over takes only people 16 and over.
form.whoJoinsTurning16: When a member turns 16, they stay in the spaces they joined before, but they can’t start or join under-16 spaces.
form.readersMembersNote: Only people in your space can read its threads.
form.readersEverybodyNote: Anyone can read it, but only under-16s can join or post.
form.postingAnyoneNote: Anyone in your space’s age group. Good for open discussion.
form.postingMembersNote: Readers can still read. Only members can start threads and reply.
form.notOwner: Only the owner can change this space.
form.classText: Only the class reads and posts here. Students join with the code you give them, never by asking.
form.kindOpenNote: People in your age group can find it and join.
form.kindClassNote: Private, for your class only. Students join with a code you give them, whatever their ages.

moderators.title: Moderators
moderators.intro: Moderators help you run the space. Choose what each one can do. Only you can add or remove moderators, and our moderation team can still act in any space.
moderators.removed: {{name}} is no longer a moderator, but stays in the space.
moderators.usernameHint: They must already be a member of this space.

members.title: Members
members.intro: Everyone in the space. Removing someone takes them out; they can ask to join again.
members.reasonHint: Goes in the space’s moderation log. They aren’t told the reason.

log.intro: Everything the owner, the moderators and our moderation team have done in this space, newest first. Only the owner and our moderation team can read it.
log.notAllowed: Only the space’s owner can read its moderation log.

classLock.title: When the class locks
classLock.intro: At the end of the school year the space locks, so nobody can post any more. Every member can still read it for as long as they have an account.

classLock.locked: The space is locked. Nobody can post here, and the class code no longer works.

classWaiting.title: Waiting to join
classWaiting.intro: Students can see and post once their account is fully active. That means the age check is done and, for under-16s, a parent or guardian has given consent.

classSpace.lockedText: Class spaces lock at the end of the school year, and nobody can post here any more. You can still read everything in it for as long as you have an account, and you keep your own stories and drafts.
classSpace.step1Title: The teacher gets a Teacher badge
classSpace.step1Text: They ask for it in Settings with a school email or a letter from the school. Our staff check it.
classSpace.step2Title: They create a space and pick “Class space”
classSpace.step2Text: Same form as any space. The class space is private and comes with an invite code.
classSpace.step3Text: The teacher writes the code on the board or shares the link. Students type it in Forums › Join a class.
classSpace.yearEndText: At the end of the school year the space locks, so nobody can post any more. Every member can still read it for as long as they have an account, and you keep your own stories and drafts.

classStories.title: Stories shared with the class
classStories.note: Only {{name}} can read these until the writer makes them public. A teacher can never make a student’s story public.
classStories.empty: No stories shared yet. To share one, open its Story settings and pick this class under “Who can read it”.
classStories.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the class’s stories. Try again in a moment.

storyClass.intro: You can share this story only with one of your classes. Then only you, the class and our moderation team can read it: it isn’t in any public list or on your profile. Only you can make it public again.
storyClass.publicNow: Right now everyone may read it, within its rating.
storyClass.sharedWithDeleted: Its class was deleted, so only you can read it now.

failures.not_yours: You can only share with a class you are in that isn’t locked.

classArchive.title: Archive the class
classArchive.intro: When the class is over, archive it. It locks now and for good: nobody can post, react, join or be invited, and nobody can unlock it again. Every member can still read it for as long as they have an account, and students keep their own stories and drafts.
classArchive.confirm: Archive the class for good? Nobody can undo this.
classArchive.archived: This class is archived. Members can still read it, and nobody can post here.
